def regions(g,col):
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0]); seen=set(); regs=[]
    for i in range(h):
        for j in range(w):
            if g[i][j]==col and (i,j) not in seen:
                stack=[(i,j)]; seen.add((i,j)); reg=[]
                while stack:
                    a,b=stack.pop(); reg.append((a,b))
                    for da,db in((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                        x,y=a+da,b+db
                        if 0<=x<h and 0<=y<w and g[x][y]==col and (x,y) not in seen:
                            seen.add((x,y)); stack.append((x,y))
                regs.append(reg)
    return regs
